name: No design system (stock Nextcloud)
description: No additional stylesheets. Nextcloud appears completely stock.

name: NL Design System
description: Dutch government design system — Fira Sans, Rijkshuisstijl defaults, Utrecht component bridge, element-level overrides.

name: Summer Breeze
description: Soft, airy light-blue design — Inter typeface, large rounded surfaces, low-contrast shadows, pastel status colours and a pale-blue gradient navigation. Gentle on the eyes.

name: High contrast (WCAG AAA)
description: Maximum-legibility black-on-white theme — pure black interactive/foreground on white, heavy borders, thick focus rings, bundled Fira Sans. Cooperates with OS high-contrast via prefers-contrast and forced-colors (EN 301 549).

name: La Suite numérique
description: Pixel-adjacent match to La Suite numérique's Cunningham design system (MIT) — the Docs/Meet/Chat suite behind MinBZK/mijn-bureau — so a Nextcloud core in a sovereign-workplace (EDIC) bundle shows no visual seam. Self-hosted Inter (SIL OFL 1.1) with Marianne resolved only via local() install; no Marianne files, no La Suite/state logos shipped.
